title: What Makes a Good Friend? Adventure
welcome_lead: Friends shape who you become — let's look closer. 👯
meta_desc: Friendship & Bullying Adventure 1 — KS3 Psychology on what makes friendships work.
final_note: You learned the qualities of good friendship and why we need it.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A friendship is a voluntary close bond.

Real friends:

  • Listen.
  • Stick up for each other.
  • Have fun.
  • Forgive small mistakes.

Trust grows when you keep secrets and turn up.

Respect means listening even when you disagree.

No trust + no respect = no real friendship.

Good friends have boundaries — limits that protect both.

Examples:

  • 'Don't share my texts.'
  • 'I don't drink — please don't push.'

Reciprocity means both give and both get. 🤝
